description: HTTP cacheability, CORS and redirect-loop explainer — Explains from supplied response headers (and optionally the request's headers, a CORS request, and a redirect chain) whether a shared and a private HTTP cache may store the response (RFC 9111 section 3), its freshness lifetime and basis (s-maxage, max-age, Expires minus Date, or the 10% Last-Modified heuristic), Vary, invalid max-age or Expires, the CORS check and preflight outcome per the Fetch S

headerNames.description: Request header names beyond the CORS-safelisted ones; safelisting by value is not evaluated.

origin.description: Serialized request origin, e.g. https://app.example, or null.

preflight.description: The supplied response is the OPTIONS preflight response.

headers.description: Only Authorization presence and Vary-selected names matter; values may be redacted.

name: http-cache-explain
